title: Record the tail coefficient that cancels flag 0
body:
## Summary
- The published tail word keeps the 4,058-event channel prefix. Its only add of `X0` into `Y34` is event 5759, with coefficient `-1/2`.
- That value is `0 - G/2` for the same ports whose normalized inner product is 1. The channel prefix ends at `+1/2`, so the two published coefficients sum to `0`.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The 280-column identity and the host schedule are not replayed.
